rca of the issue: Both P0 backend bugs from iter-354 are RESOLVED: (1) _idx_active string/int key mismatch — merged_impl was built with string keys (str(idx)) but _idx_active was looking up with int idx → Q4-a auto-terminate never fired. Fix: `merged_impl.get(str(idx)) or merged_impl.get(idx)`. (2) Replaced branch missing _active_in_treatment=True — the resolver was silently omitting the flag so Replaced implants appeared inactive downstream. Fix: explicit `merged['_active_in_treatment'] = True` in the Replaced branch. Both verified by dedicated pytests and end-to-end FE flow.
